messages.author: nora
messages.body: Moving all band chat here. One space, everything findable — no more scrolling through three group chats to find the rehearsal time.

messages.author: sam
messages.body: Rehearsal recording from Tuesday is uploaded to the channel. The new bridge section at 12:40 — THAT is the version. Listen before Thursday.

messages.author: theo
messages.body: Reminder that we told the brewery our name is Static Bloom and it is now on a poster, so the annual name-change debate is officially closed.

messages.author: nora
messages.body: Draft setlist v2 for the brewery gig: open with Copper Sky, then Undertow, new song third while ears are fresh, Fault Lines, close with Night Bus. 35 minutes with banter.

messages.author: eli
messages.body: Swap Fault Lines and the new one? The new song needs the crowd warm, and Fault Lines is bulletproof.

messages.author: sam
messages.body: Either way works but I need 30 seconds between Undertow and whatever is next — that ending destroys me.

messages.author: nora
messages.body: Both fair. v3: Copper Sky, Undertow, (Sam breathes), Fault Lines, new song, Night Bus. Locking it unless the run-through says otherwise.

messages.author: ida
messages.body: Brewery gig confirmed for the 21st! Load-in 18:00, soundcheck 18:45, on at 20:30. They feed us. I have the van, need one navigator and two lifters.

messages.author: theo
messages.body: Navigator. I also call NOT carrying my own synth case up those stairs alone, it's a two-person instrument.

messages.author: sam
messages.body: Lifting. Bringing the small kit — the corner stage won't fit the full one, I checked the photos from last time.

messages.author: nora
messages.body: Idea for autumn: tiny two-date 'tour' — brewery here, then Ida's cousin's venue in the next town. Same weekend, shared petrol. Feasible?

messages.author: eli
messages.body: The amp question, once more: keep gigging the heavy tube head, or get the modeller and save my spine? I recorded both — clips in the channel. Be honest.

messages.author: theo
messages.body: Listened blind, picked the modeller twice out of three. Your spine wins on evidence.

messages.author: ida
messages.body: The van also votes modeller. The tube head has its own postcode.

messages.author: eli
messages.body: Fine. FINE. Selling the head, keeping the cab out of sentiment, buying the modeller on Friday. Pour one out.

messages.author: theo
messages.body: New patch for the Undertow intro — recording in the channel. It finally has that underwater wobble Nora kept describing with hand gestures.

messages.author: ida
messages.body: Brewery pays 150 + food. Cousin's venue would be door split, likely 80-120. Petrol both ways about 40. Not quitting our jobs, but the tour pays for itself.

messages.author: nora
messages.body: Good enough for me. I'll ask for the 20th at the cousin's place so we keep the shared-weekend plan. Contract for the brewery is signed and in the channel.

docs.title: Gig day runbook
docs.author: nora
body: Everything we swore we'd remember after the Bergen show. Update it the moment something goes wrong again.
- [x] Drum shells first, hardware bag on top
- [ ] Merch box LAST so it comes out first
- [ ] Spare strings, 9V batteries, gaffer tape — the holy trinity
1. Drums alone, then bass, then guitars, vocals last
2. Ida's synth DI goes to channel 7 — label it, every venue asks
3. Full song, not eight bars — the chorus is where it clips
- [ ] Settle with the venue *before* the celebratory round, not after
- [ ] Theo counts merch cash, Sam recounts, nobody argues
> The Bergen rule: nobody leaves the venue until the trailer is locked. We learned this the expensive way.
